Assets.NotesMarkdown: A shorter menu: wallets sit under Clients, payment methods under Settings, notifications behind the bell and security in the user menu. New Plugins screen for Reverse, Smart dealer and Slippage. Statuses are filled badges in one colour per meaning. System groups cannot be deleted, and a group that still has accounts cannot be deleted either. The New account form has a country search, a phone field with the dialling code, and fixed width. Pop-ups no longer close on an outside click. The top bar has a search field and the broker chip, and the bottom strip shows broker, role and the UTC time.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Every table now shows its data in full contrast; only empty placeholders stay dim. Closed trades shows commission and swap with two decimals, from the broker's side: commission and the swap clients pay are positive, swap paid to a client is negative.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: A shorter menu: wallets sit under Clients, payment methods under Settings, notifications behind the bell and security in the user menu. New Plugins screen for Reverse, Smart dealer and Slippage. Statuses are filled badges in one colour per meaning. System groups cannot be deleted, and a group that still has accounts cannot be deleted either. The New account form has a country search, a phone field with the dialling code, and fixed width. Pop-ups no longer close on an outside click. The top bar has a search field and the broker chip, and the bottom strip shows broker, role and the UTC time. Groups have a real Allowed symbols window. Symbols shows which symbols are not added yet or not supported, and edits wait in a Save bar until you save. Max lots per account is edited in the Symbols table; the largest account sits on Risk radar. After a minimise the header keeps its values and the stream reconnects.
